description: Takes what your product does and the problem it solves, and returns hypotheses for who buys it: the champion, the economic buyer, the technical influencer, commercial and control reviewers and daily users, with warning signs of an anti-champion, a path to develop the champion and what to give them. Optional company name, target company type, price point and sector fit the roles to your market. These are roles to test, not named people.

price_point.description: What you charge, with the period, in your own words (for example "$50,000 a year" or "$3,750 per month")

target_company_type.description: Type of companies you target (e.g., "mid-size fintech companies", "enterprise manufacturers")

your_sector.description: Your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: impact_identify_champions
title: Identify Champions
